title: Kyle sends whole sensory experiences telepathically

tellings.quote: sends that message to you telepathically you receive the smells and the feelings

plain: A person in England named Kyle is said to send whole sensory experiences by telepathy, meaning mind to mind, with no words spoken: when he sends a message, the person receiving it gets the smells and the feelings along with it. The documentary maker Ky Dickens tells Michels this, passing on what she learned from Kyle and his mother. If true, it would mean telepathy carries much more than words or pictures.
